Vt.bar_b_note: Appealing, well-grounded stylised villager, but shown on a neutral grey stage with no Valheim-class light or atmosphere, so world finish cannot be carried.

Eo.bar_b_note: Panel follows the blue-grey translucent direction, but the dim, flat, rainy world behind it and keyboard-style glyphs sink it next to Palworld's crisp HUD.

Lf.bar_b_note: Same clean, appealing old villager as Vt, but a grey stage with no sky, fog or time-of-day grade cannot reach Valheim/Palworld finish.

Kg.bar_b_note: Flat magenta ring/chevron telegraphs, a muddy low-value forest with no purple storm sky, an unreadable player creature, and (on B) camera-in-foliage frames i12/i13/i15 sink it.

Bs.bar_b_note: Strong wolf silhouette and scale at standing, but A's floating faint mid with lost vein material and B's upended faint end and neon over-glow keep it below shipping finish.

Gc.bar_b_note: Readable smith silhouette and palette, but soft low-fidelity painted textures and small flat eyes fall short of Palworld-class character finish.

top_changes.change: Replace flat magenta ring/chevron telegraphs in Stormwood fights with real-object effects (stone, lightning, debris) with impacts, and grade Stormwood to its board (purple storm sky, blue-green moss, copper and glass highlights) to lift the muddy value range
Add camera collision/occluder fading for trunks and canopy during creature fights, and slim the combat HUD so both fighters, especially the player's creature, stay readable
Rework faint animations so creatures stay grounded (no airborne faint mid, no upended faint end) and keep their signature material through every pose
